working_definition: Author type 'Tm1' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm1 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Hth/Opa temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: 'Tm1' is FBbt:00003789 'transmedullary neuron Tm1'; at P15-P40 the cells are developing, so its immature form FBbt:00052325 (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary narrow field neuron that terminates in lobula layer 1 with a bleb-type terminal arborization and that has fine arborizations in medulla layer M2 and bleb-type arborizations in M3 and M9 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Takemura et al., 2011). In the medulla, it receives strong synaptic input from lamina monopolar neuron L2 (Takemura et al., 2011; Takemura et al., 2013). It outputs onto T5 neurons (Shinomiya et al., 2019). It is a cholinergic neuron (Varija Raghu et al., 2011; Shinomiya et al., 2014). There is usually one of these cells per optic column (Nern et al., 2025).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form; used from the pharate adult stage.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00052325 'immature transmedullary neuron Tm1' (exact match).
